intro: A correlation matrix has been established to link Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs) with the corresponding engineering competencies (ECs), knowledge and attitude profiles (WKs), as well as the targeted UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by 2030.
_NOTE_TO_USER: The PDF showed only rows for PLO-1 through PLO-5. Rows for PLO-6 through PLO-11 below are placeholders inferred from the PLO definitions in chapter 8 — please review and edit before submission.
